strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Role Addition to Cloud Accounts

analytics.name: Analytic 0771
analytics.guidance: Detection of new IAM roles or policies attached to a user/service in AWS/GCP/Azure outside normal patterns or hours, often following account compromise.

tuning.description: IAM Role type or privilege level assigned (e.g., Admin, Billing, Viewer)
User, service account, or external federated identity context performing the action
How quickly multiple roles or policies are added after initial access
Cross-account roles from outside trusted tenant list

analytics.name: Analytic 0772
analytics.guidance: Behavioral chain of a user being granted elevated privileges or roles in Entra ID or Okta following suspicious login or account creation activity.

tuning.description: Number of accounts allowed to hold sensitive roles like Global Admin
Mechanism by which role was added (PowerShell, API, UI)
Expected user-to-role mapping defined by org policy

log_sources.name: m365:audit
log_sources.channel: Add member to role, Add app role assignment

analytics.name: Analytic 0773
analytics.guidance: Detection of new admin or role assignment actions within Microsoft 365/O365 environments to elevate access for persistence or lateral movement.

tuning.description: Admin role type or application role granted
Time between initial login and privilege change
Was the role assignment local or via federated SSO account
